card.name: Digits starting a range or number
card.fires_on: Digits (or a space or open parenthesis just before a number) that begin the first number of a range such as 'range: 4 days to', or a dose figure. Most often in 'median time to onset' statements.

modes.label: Start of a time range
modes.description: First number inside '(range: X days to Y months)' after a median time to onset.
modes.example: The median time to onset of increased AST was 1.9 months (range: <<4>> days to 3.8 years).

modes.label: Inside a dose figure
modes.description: A digit or gap within a dose amount, before the rest of the number is written.

modes.label: Before a bracketed alternate dose
modes.description: An open parenthesis or space just before a second amount in a dose.

card.writes: It boosts number words like forty, eighty and quarter, so it pushes toward tens-type numbers and fractions.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number, especially the low end of a time range for when a side effect began.
